Submission Number Four - The Roval Commission

To The Hon Ronald Sackville AO QC Chair of the Royal Commission.
Another point that I would like to bring to the attention of the Royal Commission is a history
of inappropriate behaviour which the series Trapped Inside (Part I, 2, and 3): Bond
University emphasises. Around 2008, I was a Professional Legal Training (PLT) student and
Dr Christina Samios; (Her Work profile is available at:
https://au.linkedin.com/in/christinasamios) to the best of my knowledge was an academic at
Bond University Limited (Their web-site is available at: https://bond.edu.au/) and also
practicing as a professional Dr in Psychology; at Bond University Limited. We were dating
and she was a few years older than me. While, I reflect on the relationship at the time, I can
see how Bond University Limited has had a culture of inappropriate conduct with professors /
academics engaging in serious scholarly misconduct and serious sexual misconduct by
engaging in relationships with students and others in a vulnerable position. These following
Web-Links; provides strong supporting Evidence of what actually transpired at Bond
University Limited between the 1970's to current date 2019 and with their National and
International Associates: (I have successfully reported this recently to Law Enforcement
Agencies in; Australia/the United States of America/ England and to other high profile
Agencies) :
